fix(ci): replace deprecated dynamic workflow actions

Summary:
- upgrade dynamic JS workflows from actions/setup-node@v4 to v5
- replace actions-rs/toolchain with a maintained Rust toolchain action
- split the Java Maven setup into Node 24 compatible Java, Maven, and
  Maven settings actions

Rationale:
- remove the Node 20 actions runtime warnings seen in downstream
  dynamic-actions runs
- eliminate the deprecated set-output warnings emitted by the Rust
  toolchain action
- keep the workflow behavior aligned with the existing Java, JS, and
  release jobs while changing only the deprecated action wiring

Tests:
- git diff --check
- ruby -e 'require "yaml"; [".github/dyn-workflows/check.yml", ".github/dyn-workflows/release.yml"].each { |f| YAML.load_file(f) }'
